record.question: The Preamble to the Constitution is amended
record.explanation: Answer A: Once only. The Preamble’s original amendment footnotes identify both substitutions as section 2 of the Forty-second Amendment Act 1976, effective 3 January 1977. That is one amending Act/occasion, not two amendments because two phrases changed. Historical/source note: Count at the March 2010 exam date; no present political proposal is treated as an enacted amendment. Reference: https://www.legislative.gov.in/static/uploads/2025/08/7af1daa22d65f9d04c00ae9b9aa5a799.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
